text:
Mira: Morning — 5 preview seats go live Wed. Need final ops: kickoff owners, survey flow, and an automated renewal-risk flag so CSMs see bad fits early.
Owen: I can take two kickoffs (9:30am PT, 1pm PT). Leave me the slide deck and tenant list.
Luis: Ill run the 2-question survey (NPS + yes/no for integration blockers). Draft Q2: \"Did you run the sample integration? Any blockers? (yes/no)\" Link: https://forms.redwood/preview-intake.
Mira: Keep survey < 3 mins. Add a follow-up freeform only if they answer yes.
Alex: Infra note: we'll enable detailed traces for new previews for 36h instead of 48h to reduce log cost. Expect ~10% increase.
Sasha: Ill cover APAC enablement (8am SGT). Need a one-pager ops checklist: auth flow, rate limits, known gotchas.
Mira: Owen/Sasha split one-pager: Owen = product quickstart + sample prompts; Sasha = ops checklist + contact SLA. Share by EOD PST.
Owen: Will push a short MD to the repo: https://git.redwood/preview/quickstart.md (WIP).
Luis: For automation: tag survey rows with account_id, cohort=may2026_preview. Auto-flag rule suggestion: NPS <=5 OR answered integration blocker=yes OR missed kickoff twice -> tag \"preview-risk\".
Alex: ops-bot: schedule trace-mode for cohort-may2026 starting 2026-05-13T02:00Z for 36h.
ops-bot: Trace-mode scheduled by Alex for cohort-may2026: start 2026-05-13T02:00Z duration 36h.
Mira: Good. Also ask CS to log preferred contact window during kickoff — include in export.
Luis: Weekly summary CSV to cs-ops & product: columns = account_id,nps,blocker,contact_window,flagged. Example: 
account_id,nps,blocker,contact_window,flagged
acme-42,9,no,\"M-F 10-2 PT\",false
beta-11,3,yes,\"Any\",true

Sasha: Calendar invites set. One-pager ops stub added.
Owen: Quickstart draft pushed. Added a short batching recommendation and sample API call.
Mira: Can we run a 20-min triage on day 4 for any flagged accounts? Invite CSM + eng-oncall + product.
Alex: I'll ensure eng-oncall rota is aware and add a runbook snippet: 
If flagged -> collect request+response logs, check KV cache hitrate, validate model-variant fallback, escalate if p50 > 400ms.
Luis: I'll wire the survey ingestion to kafka.preview.feedback and surface the flagged list to Gainsight via an export.
Mira: Thanks all. Please confirm done here when your items are closed.
Owen: One-pager and slides pushed.
Sasha: Ops checklist added, invites sent.
Luis: Survey live and ingestion wired; tagging enabled.
Alex: Trace-mode scheduled and oncall pinged.
Mira: Perfect. Post-mortem/debrief scheduled Friday 10am PT. If anything urgent, ping me or post to #customer-success.
